scenes.what: Opening title: 'On 7th July 1986, we left this village. We came today after that day.'
Drive through mustard fields (yellow sarson) towards the range; grandfather in the car
First stop: the old family field; permission taken to enter the area
Nani (grandmother) recalls cutting crops in this field by hand; 'so hard for us to leave all this'
Arrival at the village ruins; grandmother's smile
The first house built in the village; the room where three generations were born (uploader's mother included); childhood story of being locked in the other room
Small water storage tank in front of the house
'Ghirt': handmade stone grinder with a stone wheel turned by camels; the powder was used as an alternative to cement; the village's main well and water system explained
Main pond of the village (family takes water from it)
Nostalgic moment between son and mother
Closing title repeats the 7 July 1986 departure; 'Let's gooo'
